##: Placeholders. scripts/render-packaging.mjs rewrites the version and the
hash from the artifact the release workflow just published, and refuses
to emit a file where either survived. The placeholder version appears
three times below - the version field, and twice inside the url - and
all three are rewritten together. Do not spell either placeholder out
in this comment: the renderer does a whole-file replace, so prose that
quotes one is rewritten into nonsense.
The '#/dl.7z' fragment is not decoration. Invoke-Extraction in Scoop's
lib/decompress.ps1 switches on the local filename, and a bare .exe gets
no extractor at all unless the manifest sets 'innosetup' - it would be
copied into the install dir as a setup stub instead of being unpacked.
Renaming the download to dl.7z routes it to Expand-7zipArchive, which
reads the NSIS installer without ever executing it. That matters more
than usual here, because the installer is unsigned.
NSIS rather than the .msi that the same release also publishes: Tauri's
NSIS output extracts flat, so no extract_dir is needed, where the MSI
route would have to hard-code WiX's 'PFiles/Configr' administrative
install layout and would silently extract nothing if Tauri changed it.
